About

Incorporated in 1984, North Eastern Carrying Corporation Ltd is in the
business of Transportation[1]

Key Points

Business Overview:[1][2]
The Company provides logistics and transportation services through Commercial Vehicles and Electric Commercial Vehicles (EVs), offering customised PTL, FTL, ODC and Bulk transportation solutions across India, with a strong presence in the Northern and North-Eastern regions. It also operates in Nepal, Bhutan, Tibet and border areas of Bangladesh, providing integrated services including warehousing and customs clearance.
